verdict.rationale: SerpApi publishes a public pricing page with a free tier (250 searches/month), paid plans, and automatic early renewal, all discoverable without sales contact (serpapi-docs-6, serpapi-docs-26). Community discussion on HN also references SerpApi's plan structure without any indication of a sales-gated model. Missing for 10: a full per-request/credit cost table across all paid tiers and confirmation that no enterprise tier requires contacting sales.
